set.body:
Goal: prove totality and explicit failure for hostile and damaged ASC input.

Acceptance criteria:
- Published law: every nonblank physical line is exactly one typed record, preserved unknown record, or rejected line with diagnostics.
- Property generators vary known tokens, whitespace, field counts, numeric domains, eye/layout flags, block boundaries, message text, truncation, and chunk boundaries.
- Adversarial fixtures include huge lines, invalid numbers, non-finite values, timestamp reversals, missing START/END, contradictory layouts, malformed event pairs, and converter failsafe output.
- No public pure path throws, returns null, uses sentinels, or silently drops lines.
- Failures include bounded source excerpts so an application can point to the problem without retaining the whole file.
- Deterministic seeds and minimized regression fixtures are recorded for every discovered defect.
- The existing io-diag bead may close only when this court is green on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Build the ASC line-accounting, fuzz, and corruption court
